topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: I can't believe this is happening. I've poured all my efforts into this project, night after night, sacrificing sleep, pushing through the exhaustion just to meet the deadline. The words, the ideas, they were mine, born from countless hours of research and drafts. How can anyone say I didn't do this? I need to find a way to prove it, to show them the late-night coffee cups, the empty energy drink cans piled high, the documents open on my screen for hours on end. There must be something, some way to make them see that I'm telling the truth. Just give me a chance to explain, to show them the process, the thought, the work. They have to understand.
